title: Evaluating the Deductive Competence of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM deductive competence using variations of the classic Wason selection task. The methodology manipulates presentation formats and problem content (arbitrary, shuffled, realistic social rules, and realistic non-social rules) to measure how content familiarity and format influence logical deduction and antecedent selection, scored via Domain Conditional PMI (DCPMI).
